The g(t) image on the right is also a rectangular pulse with height 1, nonzero between t=3 and t=5, and 0 at other times. Reasoning: According to the method draft, let g(t)=f(at+b). In order for the nonzero interval [3,5] of g(t) to correspond to the nonzero interval [0,1] of f(t), let the left boundary t=3 of g correspond to the input 0 of f, namely 3a+b=0; let the right boundary t=5 of g correspond to the input 1 of f, namely 5a+b=1. method.method_draft: Assume g(t) is obtained by feeding an affine-transformed time variable into f: g(t)=f(a t+b). Use the graph to identify the nonzero interval of f as [0,1] and the nonzero interval of g as [3,5]. Force the left edge of g, t=3, to correspond to the left edge of f, argument 0, and the right edge of g, t=5, to correspond to the right edge of f, argument 1. Solving 3a+b=0 and 5a+b=1 gives a=1/2, b=-3/2, so g(t)=f(t/2-3/2).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：左侧的 f(t) 图像是一个高度为 1 的矩形脉冲，在 t=0 到 t=1 之间非零，其他时间为 0。右侧的 g(t) 图像也是高度为 1 的矩形脉冲，在 t=3 到 t=5 之间非零，其他时间为 0。

推理：按照方法草案，设 g(t)=f(at+b)。为了让 g(t) 的非零区间 [3,5] 对应到 f(t) 的非零区间 [0,1]，令 g 的左边界 t=3 对应 f 的输入 0，即 3a+b=0；令 g 的右边界 t=5 对应 f 的输入 1，即 5a+b=1。两式相减得 2a=1，所以 a=1/2。代入 3a+b=0，得 3/2+b=0，因此 b=-3/2。所以 g(t)=f(t/2-3/2)。

Since g has twice the duration of f, first horizontally stretch f by factor 2, giving f(t/2), whose support would be [0,2]. Then shift this stretched pulse right by 3 units so its support becomes [3,5]. Applying the delay to the stretched signal gives f((t-3)/2), which simplifies to f(t/2-3/2).
